title: Construction of Road, Barangay Cutcut I, Capas, Tarlac
description: CONSTRUCTION OF ROAD, BARANGAY CUTCUT I, CAPAS, TARLAC, STA. 0+000 - STA. 1+344
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

items.label: Very fast award after bid opening
items.detail: Award made 6 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)

items.label: One bidder
items.detail: 1 bidder(s) recorded. Not linked to failed contracts in past data, so not scored.

items.label: Regional cost factor
items.detail: Prices for similar works in Region III (Central Luzon) run ×1.00 the national median; adjusted for the region: ₱10.3M per km vs national 95th percentile ₱40.0M.

items.label: A bidder had an earlier contract terminated
items.detail: Damico Builders & Supplies: 1 of 23 earlier road contracts terminated

families.name: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks

items.label: Political dynasties in the province (Ateneo dataset)
items.detail: 27% of Tarlac's 197 elected local positions were held by dynastic officials after the 2016 election (national median 27%, 29% in 2004); largest clan: Manuel (2.5% of positions); family poverty incidence 14% (2012).

items.label: Dynastic district representatives (2016)
items.detail: Noel Villanueva, Victor Yap (Ateneo dataset; 2016 is its latest election).

items.label: Political families in the province
items.detail: 2 of 2 elected officials in Tarlac (2025-2028) have a relative also in elective office (100%; national median 25%).

assessment.derivation: 0 strong + 2 weak signal(s) → Medium priority (1 strong, or 2 weak) → Yellow.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Find the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.
No link in DPWH's record: check PhilGEPS or ask the District Engineering Office.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Procurement competition and bidding patterns
sub: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

steps.title: Verify the risk: Contractor history and performance
sub: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check that the road and the stated length exist: compare the stations in the title with satellite imagery (Google Earth / OpenStreetMap), and look for an earlier contract on the same stretch.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
